checks.label: initial
checks.coverage: Case-inequality checks against zero after time-zero settling, at 1 ps, at 1 ns, and at each subsequent nanosecond through 101 ns; bounded timeout.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not occurred.
No synthesis, timing, or board verification performed.
justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation drives the sole one-bit output out continuously with 1'b0, matching the original specification without extra ports or latency. No subsequent RTL changes.
justified_tb_changes: Initial independent testbench checks the specified constant-zero output using four-state case inequality and startup and elapsed-time samples. No testbench revisions.
static_review: TopModule name and sole output preserved; sized constant; synthesizable continuous assignment; no clocks, resets, storage, or pipelines required.
